title: Custom Attributes Manifest
description: A file format for describing custom HTML attributes that apply globally across elements in a web component design system. Complements custom-elements.json (per-element APIs) by describing system-level HTML attribute utilities.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the custom attributes schema

name.description: The HTML attribute name as it appears in markup

description.description: Human and agent-readable description of the attribute's purpose

syntax.description: How the attribute value is structured. token-list: space-separated tokens from defined groups. enum: single value from a list. boolean: presence/absence. string: free-form.

oneOf.description: List of tag names this attribute applies to

appliesTo.description: Which elements this attribute can be used on

tokenGroups.description: Groups of related tokens. Only used when syntax is token-list.

values.description: Valid values. Only used when syntax is enum.

description.description: What this group of tokens controls

rule.description: How tokens in this group compose. oneOf: exactly one from the group. optional: zero or one. zeroOrMore: any combination.

required.description: Whether at least one token from this group must be present

requires.description: Token values from other groups that must be present for this group to be valid. Enables conditional validity (e.g. column tokens require 'grid').

values.description: The valid tokens in this group. Each entry is either a plain string token or an object with a value and description.

oneOf.description: A valid token value as it appears in the attribute

value.description: The token as it appears in the attribute value
